title: Zahrádka na balkóně
desc: Lenka zasadí jedno semínko a učí se čekat. Z poupěte je nakonec květ — a přiletí motýl.
desc_en: Lena plants a single seed and learns to wait. The bud turns into a flower, and a butterfly comes.
world: a small sunny balcony high in a city apartment building, flower pots, a watering can, rooftops and blue sky behind
setting: Malý slunný balkon vysoko v městském domě: květináče, konvička, za zábradlím střechy a modré nebe.
music: gentle springtime children's music, acoustic guitar, flute and light bells, calm and hopeful, instrumental, 85 bpm

lena.name: Lenka
lena.desc: a sweet 7-year-old girl with long light brown hair in two braids, freckles and a big smile, wearing a pink dress with a white apron and green rubber boots
lena.look: Milá sedmiletá holčička s dlouhými světle hnědými vlasy ve dvou copech a pihami, v růžových šatech s bílou zástěrou a zelených holínkách.

butterfly.name: motýl
butterfly.desc: a big friendly blue butterfly with shiny sky-blue wings with white spots and a cute smiling face
butterfly.look: Velký přátelský modrý motýl s lesklými blankytnými křídly s bílými tečkami a usměvavou tvářičkou.

shots.action: Lenka na balkoně drží v otevřené dlani jediné semínko a s úžasem si ho prohlíží.
shots.keyframe: Lena on the balcony holds a single seed in her open palm and looks at it with wonder
shots.motion: Lena opens her palm, looks closely at the tiny seed and smiles
shots.narration: Lenka dostala od babičky jedno semínko.
shots.narration_en: Grandma gave Lena one tiny seed.

shots.action: Lenka zamáčkne semínko prstem do hlíny v hliněném květináči a hlínu uhladí.
shots.keyframe: Lena presses a seed into the soil of a small clay pot on the balcony
shots.motion: Lena pushes the seed into the soil with one finger, pats the soil flat and sits back
shots.narration_en: She planted it in a little pot.

shots.action: Lenka zalévá květináč malou zelenou konvičkou a pak ji postaví vedle.
shots.keyframe: Lena waters a small clay pot on the balcony with a green watering can
shots.motion: Lena tips the watering can, water sprinkles on the soil, then she sets the can down

shots.action: Lenka sedí u okna s bradou v dlaních a dívá se, jak teplý déšť kropí květináč.
shots.keyframe: Lena sits by the window and watches warm rain fall on her clay pot on the balcony
shots.motion: Lena watches the rain through the window, raindrops fall on the pot, she rests her chin on her hands
shots.narration_en: It rained. The seed drank the water.

shots.action: Lenka leží na balkoně na sluníčku vedle květináče, protáhne se a se zavřenýma očima se usmívá.
shots.keyframe: Lena lies on the balcony floor in bright sunshine next to the clay pot, smiling at the sun
shots.motion: the sun shines, Lena stretches her arms, closes her eyes and smiles
shots.narration_en: Then the warm sun came out.

shots.action: Lenka klečí u květináče s holou hlínou, poklepe na něj a zamračí se. Povzdechne si, opře bradu o kolena a čeká dál.
shots.keyframe: Lena kneels next to a clay pot of bare soil, looking sad and impatient
motion: Lena looks at the bare soil, taps the pot gently and frowns
Lena sighs, puts her chin on her knees and keeps waiting
shots.narration: Ale nic nerostlo. Lenka čekala a čekala a čekala.
shots.narration_en: But nothing grew. Lena waited, and waited, and waited.

shots.action: Z hlíny vykoukne drobný zelený klíček a rozvine dva lístky. Lenka vykulí oči a zakryje si pusu.
shots.keyframe: a tiny green sprout peeks out of the soil in the clay pot, Lena gasps in surprise behind it
shots.motion: the tiny sprout slowly unfolds two little leaves, Lena's eyes grow wide and she covers her mouth
shots.narration_en: One morning, a little green leaf peeked out!

shots.action: V květináči roste vysoký stonek s poupětem. Lenka si ho měří dlaní a poupě se kývá ve vánku.
shots.keyframe: a tall green stem with a closed flower bud grows in the clay pot, Lena measures it with her hand
shots.motion: Lena holds her hand next to the stem to measure it, the bud sways a little in the breeze
shots.narration: Rostl a rostl, až měl poupě.
shots.narration_en: It grew and grew, and then a bud appeared.

shots.action: Na poupě přiletí modrý motýl. Lenka se nakloní blíž a usměje se.
shots.keyframe: the blue butterfly lands on the closed flower bud in the clay pot while Lena watches with delight
shots.motion: the butterfly flutters down and lands on the bud, Lena leans in closer and smiles
shots.narration: Přiletěl modrý motýl a sedl si na poupě.
shots.narration_en: A blue butterfly came and sat on the bud.

shots.action: Poupě se pomalu rozvine ve velký růžový květ, motýl vzlétne a Lenka tleská.
shots.keyframe: the bud opens into a big pink flower, the blue butterfly flutters above it, Lena claps
shots.motion: the bud slowly opens into a big pink flower, the butterfly lifts off and Lena claps her hands
shots.narration: Poupě se rozvinulo v krásný růžový květ.
shots.narration_en: The bud opened into a lovely pink flower.

shots.action: Lenka tančí vedle růžového květu pomalou radostnou rumbu.
shots.keyframe: Lena stands on the balcony next to the pink flower, happy, ready to dance
shots.motion: Lena dances a slow happy rumba on the spot, swaying her hips and moving her arms gracefully, same pink dress, same balcony
shots.narration: Lenka tančila kolem svého prvního kvítku.
shots.narration_en: Lena danced around her very first flower.

shots.action: Balkon je plný kvetoucích květin všech barev. Lenka je zalévá, kolem létají motýli a ona se usměje do kamery.
shots.keyframe: the balcony is full of blooming flowers of every color, Lena waters them, butterflies fly around her
shots.motion: Lena waters the flowers, butterflies float around her, she looks at the camera and smiles
shots.narration: Za rok byl celý balkon plný květin.
shots.narration_en: A year later, the balcony was full of flowers.
